DETECTION TECHNIQUE: Thermal and optical cameras on poles

Pancake collapse of floor slabs.requires: slabs falling flat onto one another
Pancake collapse of floor slabs.provides: almost no void space, very low survival probability, heavy lifting required

Lean-to void formation.requires: a slab coming to rest against a wall
Lean-to void formation.provides: survivable voids along one edge, accessible from the standing side

Soft-storey failure.provides: upper floors intact and occupied, the void confined to one level

Unreinforced masonry disintegration.provides: shallow burial in rubble, casualties reachable by hand

Acoustic listening devices.requires: a quiet site and a conscious casualty
Acoustic listening devices.provides: location of anyone able to make noise, defeated by ambient noise

Search dogs.requires: a trained dog and a workable surface
Search dogs.provides: rapid indication of living casualties, no depth or precise position

Thermal and optical cameras on poles.requires: an existing void to insert into
Thermal and optical cameras on poles.provides: visual confirmation inside a void, nothing through solid material

Structural survey only.provides: identification of likely void locations, no confirmation anyone is alive

Selective debris removal by hand.provides: no risk of further collapse, very slow for deep casualties

Breaching and breaking concrete.requires: powered tools and a stable slab
Breaching and breaking concrete.provides: access through a slab to a known void, vibration risk to the casualty

Heavy lifting with cranes.requires: crane access and a stable footing
Heavy lifting with cranes.provides: removal of large elements, uncontrolled shifting of what remains

Shoring then tunnelling.requires: timber or hydraulic shoring and trained crews
Shoring then tunnelling.provides: a protected route to a deep casualty, many hours per casualty

First six hours.provides: high survival probability, most live rescues occur here

Beyond one week.provides: recovery rather than rescue, transition to demolition
